Cobalt credit union is nothing but a scam. I do not have a vehicle, so I had someone take me to the bank to deposit cash so that my account would not go negative. Their systems were down so I couldn’t deposit my money. My account went negative because of it and they refuse to refund any fees because I “could’ve came back in a few days” when in reality I shouldn’t be held responsible for what their system caused. Absolutely terrible company and I rarely leave their business happy. Money comes first. No the customer. No accountability at all. I have no issue with the worker at the branch, but the higher ups who refuse to run a respectable business have forced me to switch banks. Rude and distasteful and I honestly hope the whole branch goes under.
